review_scope: one representative excerpt for each of 14 CWE categories
scope_note: These 14 entries are examples selected from a 71-candidate intake. Findings must not be extrapolated to all 71 candidates.
source_verification: GitHub pull-request origin and full historical context have not been independently validated for every row; no source is automatically approved or deleted.

entries.label: Path Traversal
entries.reason: SSH path normalization, escaping and private-key file permissions are shown; the excerpt does not establish a path traversal defect.

entries.label: OS Command Injection
entries.reason: A shell-command allowlist was introduced before exec(); potential command-injection mitigation, but command sources and bypass conditions require verification.

entries.label: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
entries.reason: ApexCharts tooltip formatting was changed to interpolate labels into HTML. The excerpt does not show XSS remediation; direct interpolation may create an HTML-injection risk.

entries.label: SQL Injection
entries.reason: A broad migration from parameterized MSSQL requests to Sequelize is visible. The removed requests already use bound parameters; a specific SQL-injection fix is not established.

entries.label: Code Injection
entries.reason: Dynamically generated inline JavaScript imports were replaced by script.src assignment. This may reduce code-construction risk, but trust boundaries for src remain unknown.

entries.label: Improper Authentication
entries.reason: A middleware requiring expected session fields was added to a route. The change plausibly addresses an authentication workflow gap, subject to confirmation of the original risk and middleware placement.

entries.label: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
entries.reason: The client switched from plain axios to a configured axiosInstance. Authentication effects depend on the axiosInstance implementation and the server-side authorization policy, neither shown.

entries.label: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
entries.reason: CSRF middleware was introduced for routes outside /api. Applicability to affected state-changing cookie-authenticated routes must be confirmed; API routes are exempted.

entries.label: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
entries.reason: Browser-side file type recognition now falls back to a filename extension. This alone does not demonstrate server-side upload restrictions or remediation of dangerous file upload.

entries.label: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference (XXE)
entries.reason: Prescription JSON/IndexedDB import refactor contains no identifiable XML external entity configuration or XXE mitigation.

entries.label: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
entries.reason: Dynamic innerHTML construction was replaced by DOM creation and textContent; this resembles output-encoding/XSS mitigation, not removal of hard-coded credentials.

entries.label: Missing Authorization
entries.reason: A frontend component dispatches to credential-library form types. No enforcement of an authorization check is visible.

entries.label: Incorrect Authorization
entries.reason: Role-management UI uses a corrected permission type identifier for View Group Users. May fix incorrect mapping, but backend enforcement and the original permission defect must be verified.

entries.label: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
entries.reason: URL validation limits protocol, form, and length, but does not establish defenses against loopback/private networks, DNS rebinding, or server-side URL fetches. Not an evidenced SSRF correction.
